subject: maths

concepts.title: Direction Cosines of a Line
concepts.definition: The cosines of the angles that a directed line makes with the positive x, y, and z axes are its direction cosines.
concepts.key_idea: A unique set of three values representing the orientation of a line in 3D space.
question_patterns: find the direction cosines if angles are given
calculate the direction cosines for a line making angles ... with axes
what are the direction cosines of the x-axis
verify if the given values are direction cosines
Explain the method of Direction Cosines of a Line.

solution_steps.explain: Identify the angles alpha, beta, and gamma made with the x, y, and z axes.
Calculate l = cos(alpha), m = cos(beta), and n = cos(gamma).
Confirm that l^2 + m^2 + n^2 = 1 to ensure the cosines form a valid direction cosine set.

concepts.title: Direction Cosines from Direction Ratios
concepts.definition: Direction ratios are any three numbers proportional to the direction cosines; they can be converted to cosines by normalizing with the magnitude.
concepts.key_idea: Normalization of direction ratios yields the direction cosines.
question_patterns: find direction cosines from direction ratios
given direction ratios a, b, c find l, m, n
convert direction numbers to direction cosines
Explain the method of Direction Cosines from Direction Ratios.
Describe the approach of Direction Cosines from Direction Ratios.

solution_steps.explain: Square each direction ratio and sum them up.
Find the square root of the sum of squares.
The direction cosine l is the ratio a divided by the magnitude.

concepts.title: Direction Cosines of Line Joining Two Points
concepts.definition: The direction cosines of a line segment connecting two points are found by dividing the coordinate differences by the distance between the points.
question_patterns: find direction cosines of the line passing through points P and Q
calculate DCs for a line segment joining two coordinates
what are the direction ratios of the line through (x1,y1,z1) and (x2,y2,z2)
Explain the method of Direction Cosines of Line Joining Two Points.
Describe the approach of Direction Cosines of Line Joining Two Points.

solution_steps.explain: Subtract the coordinates of the first point from the second.
Find the Euclidean distance between the two points.
Divide the x-difference by the distance.

concepts.title: Cartesian Equation of a Line
concepts.definition: A line in 3D space can be expressed as a set of ratios involving a fixed point and its direction ratios.
concepts.key_idea: Every point on the line satisfies the proportionality of its relative coordinates to the direction ratios.
question_patterns: find the cartesian equation of the line passing through point ... and parallel to vector ...
write the equation of a line with direction ratios a, b, c
convert vector equation to cartesian form
Explain the method of Cartesian Equation of a Line.
Describe the approach of Cartesian Equation of a Line.

solution_steps.explain: Identify the fixed point (x1, y1, z1) the line passes through.
Set up the proportion (x - x1)/a = (y - y1)/b = (z - z1)/c using the point and direction ratios.
Identify the direction ratios a, b, c from the parallel vector or given data.

concepts.title: Angle Between Two Lines
concepts.definition: The angle between two lines is the angle between their respective direction vectors, calculated using the dot product formula.
concepts.key_idea: The cosine of the angle is the absolute dot product of normalized direction vectors.
question_patterns: find the angle between the pair of lines
calculate the acute angle between lines with direction ratios ...
what is the angle between lines given in cartesian form
Explain the method of Angle Between Two Lines.
Describe the approach of Angle Between Two Lines.

solution_steps.explain: Multiply corresponding direction ratios and sum them.
Find the magnitude of each direction vector.
Divide the absolute dot product by the product of magnitudes.

concepts.title: Condition for Perpendicular Lines
concepts.definition: Two lines are perpendicular if the sum of the products of their corresponding direction ratios is zero.
concepts.key_idea: Orthogonality in 3D is equivalent to a zero dot product of direction vectors.
question_patterns: show that the lines are perpendicular
find p such that the lines are at right angles
verify if two lines intersect at 90 degrees
Explain the method of Condition for Perpendicular Lines.
Describe the approach of Condition for Perpendicular Lines.

solution_steps.explain: Get (a1, b1, c1) and (a2, b2, c2) from the line equations.
Verify if a1*a2 + b1*b2 + c1*c2 equals zero.
If the dot product is zero, the lines are perpendicular; otherwise, they are not at right angles.

concepts.title: Shortest Distance Between Skew Lines
concepts.definition: The shortest distance between two non-parallel, non-intersecting lines is the length of the common perpendicular segment.
concepts.key_idea: Projection of the vector joining two points on the lines onto the common perpendicular vector.
question_patterns: find the shortest distance between skew lines
calculate distance between lines r = a1 + lb1 and r = a2 + mb2
what is the shortest distance between the given lines
Explain the method of Shortest Distance Between Skew Lines.
Describe the approach of Shortest Distance Between Skew Lines.

solution_steps.explain: Calculate the components of the cross product of direction vectors b1 and b2.
Find the magnitude of the cross product vector.
Calculate the dot product of the cross product and the difference of position vectors.
Divide the absolute dot product by the cross product magnitude.

concepts.title: Distance Between Parallel Lines
concepts.definition: The distance between two parallel lines is the perpendicular distance from any point on one line to the other line.
concepts.key_idea: Magnitude of the cross product of the direction vector and the point-difference vector, normalized by the direction vector's length.
question_patterns: find the distance between parallel lines
calculate the distance between r = a1 + lb and r = a2 + mb
how far apart are the parallel lines
Explain the method of Distance Between Parallel Lines.
Describe the approach of Distance Between Parallel Lines.

solution_steps.explain: Subtract coordinates of point on line 1 from point on line 2.
Calculate magnitude of cross product of b and (a2-a1).
Calculate magnitude of the common direction vector b.
Divide numerator by denominator.
